name: SSL Labs
tagline: Public TLS/SSL server analysis and grading
description: SSL Labs provides a public REST API for analyzing and grading the TLS/SSL configuration of public web servers. Developers can submit hostnames for assessment, poll analysis progress, and retrieve detailed certificate, protocol, cipher, and grade results without API-key authentication under published usage guidelines.

auth.details: No API key required; public free API. An identifying User-Agent is recommended for client tools but is not documented as a hard protocol requirement.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API intended mainly for operators testing their own infrastructure; commercial use generally requires explicit Qualys permission. Usage also governed by dynamic rate limits and fair-use guidelines (no paid public API tier).

rate_limits: Limits are dynamic: query GET /info for maxAssessments, currentAssessments, and newAssessmentCoolOff; honor response headers X-Max-Assessments and X-Current-Assessments. Excess new assessments receive HTTP 429. Prefer low concurrency and moderate polling (e.g. ~5s then ~10s).
use_cases: check SSL certificate chain and expiry details for a host
list supported protocols and cipher suites for a server
poll assessment status until SSL Labs scan completes
compare TLS grades across multiple hostnames
